numbers.value: 0 (Q_TF below 1e-12 of the second moment while the size changes by a factor 1.7)

note: A lone body in GR without Lambda, in a static empty space: a lone free-falling body moves uniformly in any inertial frame, its mass and momentum are conserved and its quadrupole is quadratic in time, so it radiates exactly nothing; a spherical pulsation also radiates nothing (Birkhoff). Loss needs something else: non-spherical motion of its own parts, a second body (power falls as m^2), or Lambda's horizon (wave D7). Sun and Earth are an illustrative AI choice. Nearest theory: Birkhoff's theorem, equivalence principle, quadrupole formula (Einstein 1918; Peters and Mathews 1963). Not UET-distinct. Limit (author, 2026-11-23): Schwarzschild is static; it puts the body in an empty space that already exists forever, so D11 answers a frozen picture, not the author's universe that begins and is dynamic; that needs a dynamic GR solution (AI candidates: a closed dust Friedmann universe, the Oppenheimer-Snyder interior, Lemaitre-Tolman-Bondi).
